start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aap batayiye, rectangle kya hota hai?

turns.line: mujhe koi aur topic padhna hai
turns.reply: Kabir, woh topic aapki class ke lessons mein nahi hai. Aaj ka work naye tareeke se karein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein?
Theek hai Kabir, vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing sochiye—poori boundary ki lambai ko perimeter kahenge. Aap kya jodenge?

turns.line: mujhe koi aur topic padhna hai
turns.reply: Kabir, kisi aur topic ko baad mein rakhiye; ab perimeter par lautkar rectangle ki sabhi sides jodne ka try kijiye—kaun-si sides jodenge?
Perimeter matlab boundary ki total length: polygon ki har side ko ek-ek karke add kijiye. Rectangle mein kaun-si chaar sides jodenge?

turns.line: mujhe koi aur topic padhna hai
turns.reply: Kabir, theek hai—isi lesson mein naya tareeka: perimeter ko boundary-walk samajhiye. Aap rectangle ke chaaron kinaaron par kaise chalenge?
